info.name: ASMO AI Search API - Frontend
info.description:
ASMO AI Search API for frontend integration.

POST /v1/search takes multipart/form-data: channel (web|mobile), language (en), and any of search_query, image, filters (JSON string), sort_by (relevance|price), sort_order (asc|desc), page, page_size (1-200), query_embedding_id, image_embedding_id.

Image: send a .bin file (file name ending in .bin) as application/octet-stream, max 5 MB; the bytes must be a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image. In the browser: form.append('image', blob, 'image.bin'). Any other file gets 400 "Incorrect file format. Only .bin files are accepted."

Errors always return {"code": "...", "message": "..."}.

Set base_url to the API address. Upload files are in test_images/ next to this collection.
